article.headline: Ryan Archey's 21 points guide North Carolina Central over NAIA's Carolina University 105-46
article.description: — Ryan Archey scored 21 points as North Carolina Central beat NAIA member Carolina University 105-46 on Monday.
article.linkText: Ryan Archey's 21 points guide North Carolina Central over NAIA's Carolina University 105-46

event.description: Carolina University Bruins @ North Carolina Central Eagles

keywords: Carolina University Bruins @ North Carolina Central Eagles
article.story: DURHAM, N.C. -- — Ryan Archey scored 21 points as North Carolina Central beat NAIA member Carolina University 105-46 on Monday. Archey went 9 of 12 from the field (3 for 4 from 3-point range) for the Eagles (2-5). Cristian Sanon scored 15 points, finishing 5 of 6 from 3-point range. Darius Kane had 14 points and went 6 of 7 from the field. Noah Jones led the Bruins with nine points. Up next: North Carolina Central’s next game is Saturday against Gardner-Webb on the road. Carolina University visits Appalachian State on Tuesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
